Today's AI landscape is shifting from experimentation to real-world deployment. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a production milestone as adoption triples, while startups increasingly let model-driven agents replace hand-coded orchestration. Tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for frontier models, and multi-agent swarms are entering regulated enterprise workflows. To support this growth, observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end.
